results.title: ApartmentADDA: Silicon Valley investors back Bangalore online startup - The Economic Times
results.body: November 13, 2013 - BANGALORE: A group of Silicon Valley and Indian investors is backing a Bangalore-based startup ApartmentADDA that provides online software to manage residential complexes. The company and the investors decline to disclose financial details. "Increasing migration to urban areas will continue to bring tremendous growth in new townships, apartments and villa communities," said Bhupen Shah, a Silicon Valley angel investor who teamed up with others including Sharad Sharma, Raghu Tarra, Vijay Anand and Zaheer Rattonsey to fund the five-year old company.
